quotes.text: Our company took a fishing trip yesterday with the California Dawn, such a cool bonding experience. Being a beginner myself I would recommend this trip for other beginners because the entire crew makes you feel welcome immediately and they are so helpful and very knowledgeable. We all had an awesome day and everyone caught so many fish, 10 out of 10 stars, would so do this again!!
